mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, acc_name, type, init_balance, balance, allow_overdraft, create_time FROM account WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account (user_id, acc_name, type, init_balance, balance, allow_overdraft) VALUES (#{userId}, #{accName}, #{type}, #{initBalance}, #{balance}, #{allowOverdraft})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM account WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.acc_name AS accName, a.init_balance AS initBalance, a.balance, a.init_balance + COALESCE(SUM(CASE r.type WHEN 'INCOME' THEN r.amount ELSE -r.amount END), 0) AS calc, a.balance - (a.init_balance + COALESCE(SUM(CASE r.type WHEN 'INCOME' THEN r.amount ELSE -r.amount END), 0)) AS diff FROM account a LEFT JOIN `record` r ON r.account_id = a.id AND r.user_id = a.user_id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY a.id, a.acc_name, a.init_balance, a.balance ORDER BY a.id ASC
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(balance), 0) FROM account WHERE user_id = #{userId}
